Daily Devotional

September 2

8 And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed. 9 But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light: (1 Peter 2:8-9 KJV)

Jesus was a stumbling stone to those who didn’t accept Him. Jesus was the greatest gift God ever gave to mankind, but became a stumbling stone to the ones who refused to accept Him, and it was prophesied in the Old Testament that this would happen (Isaiah 8:14). Jesus also referred to himself as the corner stone that was rejected by the church (Matthew 21:42), and He has become the corner stone of the New Covenant Church – praise God!

We, who are born again Christians, are the true people of God, and all these good things are spoken of us. The Greek word “GENOS” that was translated generation in this verse, means “kin”, or translated sometimes as nation or race, so it is speaking of us being the people of God. What a wonderful thing it is, to be able to be the people of God, just by making Jesus our Lord and Savior (Romans 10:9-10). If we could just understand the love that God has for us, we would be overcome with love for Him. Serving God through love is so much superior than trying to serve Him through the law, with all the condemnation and fear that it brings. God is so good, and all good things come from Him (James 1:17). I don’t know why anyone would not want to be a child of God, as it is absolutely wonderful to have our almighty God for a Father. He is so good to His children. Thank you Jesus for all you have done for us!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
